timestampNote: startedAt records the first preserved source snapshot, after initial log/source inspection began.
method: Inspected the three actual Linux full failures and current bounded sources. Preserved original bytes and SHA-256 before repair. Reproduced the UI race locally, requested a root-owned fresh isolated Linux diagnostic for the two platform-specific native failures, and checked pinned official 0.164.0 source before choosing minimal product and fixture corrections. Ran exact affected Windows tests and no-emit checks; independently read root-provided Linux results and checked overlay hashes. No full suite or SSH was run by this agent.

findings.trigger: web/tests/organization.test.tsx expected nativeProjectId native-folder but received null
findings.rootCause: Thread metadata and choices could be rendered and saved while nativeProjectId/sectionId still held their initial empty strings. A later passive useEffect copied the loaded defaults, so the first interactive render could submit an unintended removal.
findings.fix: Represent only explicit project/section edits as local state. Derive untouched selections directly from current thread.data during rendering. Nullish fallback retains explicit empty strings; successful saves clear edit state, failed saves retain it, and changing section still clears ordering.
findings.validation: The original project assertion failed locally against the original product. Final exact organization file passes 10/10, including the unchanged project assertion, unedited section preservation, and deliberate empty project/section values. Web TypeScript passed.
findings.boundary: UI validation ran in local Windows jsdom, not a new Linux browser session. The broader full rerun belongs to root.

findings.trigger: gateway-oauth-native allowlist rejected CONNECT github.com:443 on Linux
findings.rootCause: The pinned CLI enables plugins by default. Curated plugin startup selects a trusted system Git executable and tries github.com/openai/plugins.git before the already-accounted GitHub API fallback. The Linux denial proxy recorded this extra CONNECT; it returned 503 and did not establish an external tunnel. The assertion was coupling gateway readiness to unrelated plugin startup transport availability.
findings.fix: Only the isolated account-readiness fixture sets features.plugins=false. The original CONNECT allowlist and request cap remain unchanged; the proxy still denies every request. Add a direct assertion that no configured responses.invalid or login.invalid endpoint is contacted and use the existing nativeTestEnvironment helper for isolated homes and system-key inheritance.
findings.validation: The root-owned Linux diagnostic retained the original allowlist and reproduced the exact unexpected CONNECT. After the fixture correction, exact gateway/workflows tests pass 2/2 on both Windows and fresh Linux with fixed CLI 0.164.0. Gateway remains required/notReady with error null for three reads and emits no automatic authorization-start notification.
findings.boundary: This does not disable plugins in product configuration, authorize external requests, prove actual OAuth login, or exercise a real gateway account. The test proxy rejects all traffic and Linux runs used PrivateNetwork.

findings.trigger: workflows-native waited for an automatic turn/started after resume, but no such event arrived
findings.rootCause: The original fixture closed a process while a turn was held, then assumed the recovered queue would automatically start. Linux diagnostics showed two provider requests, a loaded idle thread, one preserved queued item, and no auto-start. The pinned upstream test and queue service explicitly preserve interrupted queues across cold resume until a selected queued item is started; process-shutdown timing made the previous fixture platform-dependent.
findings.fix: Explicitly interrupt the held turn and wait for its matching turn/completed with interrupted status before closing. After restart, verify queue/goal persistence and session resume, rehydrate history, explicitly call thread/queue/start with the saved item id, require the returned turn id in turn/started and completed status, and require the queue to become empty. Completion checks now assert completed versus interrupted as appropriate; original fork/revert/history/steer/review and cleanup assertions remain.
findings.validation: Original Linux diagnostic reproduced the stuck auto-start expectation. Revised exact tests pass 2/2 on Windows and Linux; the Linux overlay includes the separate service.ts activity fix and matches current hashes.
findings.boundary: The revised test proves explicit interruption, durable queue/goal state, and explicit queued continuation. It does not claim automatic continuation after abrupt process death, and no production queue-start behavior was changed.

sources.purpose: The curated plugin sync tries trusted git against github.com/openai/plugins.git before GitHub HTTP and backup archive fallback.
Plugin startup and curated synchronization are gated by plugins_enabled.
The stable plugins feature is enabled by default and has the config key plugins.
The upstream regression preserves queued messages after interruption and cold resume, then explicitly starts a selected queued item.
Explicit queue start selects an item; automatic idle dispatch excludes interrupted state.
